title: crud.pagination config
description: Appears as blueprint.components[].config. Maps to mortar.crud. Per-entity choices (sortable and searchable fields) are code in the controller subclass, not config.

defaultPageSize.description: Page size when a request has no size. Maps to mortar.crud.default-page-size.

maxPageSize.description: Largest accepted size; larger values get 400. Must be at least defaultPageSize. Maps to mortar.crud.max-page-size.
